translate_en|mods/Frockin Stompers!/42/m: Container Loot Multiplier: Store & Storage Items - Common

This is the loot multiplier for common spawns (default chance more than 1.000) for Frockin Stompers!, such as items that are spawning in commercial areas. Set the number to 0 to stop this category from spawning, set the number to 10 to have them appear in almost all containers.
Container Loot Multiplier: Loose Items - Very Rare

This is the loot multiplier for very rare spawns (default chance 0.001-0.010) for Frockin Stompers!, such as loose items in residential and functional areas. Set the number to 0 to stop this category from spawning, set the number to 1000 to have them appear in almost all containers.
